settings.title: Settings
settings.admin_password_help_new: Password for the user root, realm "Linux PAM" (login root@pam). Required for the first configuration.
settings.admin_password_help_set: A password is set. Leave empty to keep it; enter a new one to replace it. The module applies it at every start, so changes made inside the Proxmox Datacenter Manager interface are not permanent.
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.admin_password_required: A password is required for the first configuration
settings.admin_password_too_short: The password must have at least 8 characters
settings.invalid_admin_password: The password must have at most 128 characters and must not contain control characters
settings.first_setup_help: Chosen once, when the module is configured for the first time. They cannot be changed afterwards.
settings.first_setup_locked: These options were chosen at the first configuration and are shown for information only.
settings.opt_tls_import: Use the Traefik certificate in the Certificates page
settings.opt_ns8_layout: NS8 layout: menu order, Shell and Administration in the top bar
settings.opt_debian_extra: Add the Debian components contrib and non-free-firmware
settings.opt_hide_registry: Hide the menu entry Subscription Registry
